# Fixture rule sets

Shared, named rule-set snapshots used by the engine golden files (`../golden/*.json`, member `ruleset` = file name without `.json`) and by the property tests.

**Every file here is illustrative, not medically verified.** Each snapshot carries `"illustrative": true`, the machine-checkable marker of a fixture or demo rule set (a publish gate can refuse it). Ages, intervals and milestones were chosen to exercise engine semantics (SAD §5.1–§5.3), not copied from a cited schedule. Never use them as clinical data, and never copy them into an editorial rule set.

Rules for this folder:

- A fixture holds only fields of the current snapshot contract. New fields arrive with the slice that adds them.
- Every fixture passes `ruleset.Validate` with zero problems and loads with `engine.New`. Rule sets that must be rejected live in `ruleset/testdata/validate/`.
- Every fixture is referenced by at least one golden file.
- Changing a fixture changes every golden that uses it: re-derive those goldens by hand.
- A fixture's `version` names an immutable snapshot: a changed fixture gets a new version (`illustrative-vn-s1` became `illustrative-vn-s2` when S2 added `hpv`).

| File | Shape | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `illustrative-vn.json` | `pertussis` with alternative plans 2-3-4 and 2-4-6 months (3 doses each); `measles` with one 2-dose plan (9 and 18 months); since version `illustrative-vn-s2`, a generic `hpv` series (no product), plan 0-2-6: dose 1 min age 9y at 9y, dose 2 min interval 4w at `firstDose` + 2m, dose 3 min interval 12w and `minIntervalFromFirst` 5m at `firstDose` + 6m | F13.2 cases, alternative-plan merge, A9; S2: level-4 and implied doses, `minIntervalFromFirst`, no birth date, two birth ends, range-based `DATE_IN_FUTURE`; S3a: no products, so every product ID is `UNKNOWN_PRODUCT`, and the Q47 regression (a beyond-series chain failure through `minIntervalFromFirst`). The products of the F13.2 cases are modelled in `illustrative-products`, not here (issue #14, Q41) |
| `minimal-single.json` | one plan: dose 1 min age 6w at 2m; dose 2 min interval 4w at 4m; no buffer | dose validity, A4, buffer 0 boundaries, inclusive minimum interval and earliest date, complete; S2: month-precision doses, overlap, numbering conflicts, year- and month-precision birth, no birth date, range-based `DATE_BEFORE_BIRTH` |
| `minimal-alt-plans.json` | plans `fast` (4w, at 3m) and `slow` (8w, at 4m) for dose 2 | earliest date taken from the earliest-due plan (A7), per-plan dose validity |
| `minimal-buffer.json` | dose 1 at 2m, dose 2 at 12m, buffer 14d on both | buffer > 7 days, 30-day and 6-month boundaries |
| `minimal-late-start.json` | one dose, min age 9m at 9m, buffer 14d | first dose at the 6-month boundary, month clamping |
| `minimal-anchors.json` | dose 1 at 9y; dose 2 at `firstDose` + 2m; dose 3 at `previousDose` + 4m (min interval 12w) | milestone anchors, minimum age in years |
| `minimal-short-buffer.json` | one dose, min age 6w at 2m, buffer 3d | the 7-day grace is a floor, not a default (O = Du + max(buffer, 7d)) |
| `minimal-alt-plans-crossed.json` | plans `early-due` (8w, at 3m) and `late-due` (4w, at 4m) for dose 2: the earliest-due plan has the later earliest date | earliest date from the earliest-due plan, not the smallest earliest date (A7) |
| `minimal-first-dose-anchor.json` | dose 1 at 9y; doses 2 and 3 at `firstDose` + 2m and + 6m (HPV 0-2-6 shape) | `firstDose` anchor for a dose after dose 2 |
| `minimal-alt-plans-tied.json` | plans `short` (4w) and `long` (6w) for dose 2, both at 4m: the plans tie on the due date | tied due dates take the latest earliest date (SAD §5.3 step 7 merge 1) |
| `minimal-age-only.json` | dose 1 min age 6w at 2m; dose 2 min age 4m only (no interval) at 4m; dose 3 min interval 4w at 6m | an overlap resolved by user numbers with no interval to fail (S2); a minimum age not implied by dose 1's minimum age plus the intervals (6w + 0 < 4m), so no birth date gives `NO_BIRTH_DATE` (SAD §5.2, EQ19) |
| `illustrative-products.json` | since S3a (version `illustrative-products-s3a`): `rota` with products `rotarix`, `rotateq` and `rotasiil` (live) and product series `rota-rotarix` (2 doses: min age 6w at 2m; 4w at 4m) and `rota-rotateq` (3 doses: min age 6w at 10w; 4w at 4m; 4w at 6m), no generic rota series, `rotasiil` with no series; `pertussis` with products `hexaxim` and `pertu2` (not live), the generic `pertussis-primary` (plans 2-3-4 and 2-4-6 as in `illustrative-vn`) and `pertussis-pertu2` (2 doses: min age 6w at 2m; 8w at 4m) | products and candidate series (S3a): candidates per dose and their union (A2), `SAFEST_SERIES`, the merge across candidates (EQ6 item 2), candidates that disagree on a minimum (Q31), implied doses as unknown products (Q30), off-catalog products (`PRODUCT_NOT_IN_CATALOG`), `products`, record-scoped `UNKNOWN_PRODUCT` |
| `minimal-retired-product.json` | since S3a: `rota` with `rotarix` and a retired `rotateq`, series as in `illustrative-products`; `hib` whose only product `hib-old` is retired, with one series `hib-old-primary` (1 dose, min age 6w at 2m) | retired products: doses count as unknown products without `PRODUCT_NOT_IN_CATALOG` (Q29); no dose given, retired products' series are excluded, with the fallback to every series (Q38) |
| `minimal-crossed-candidates.json` | since S3a: one disease `duo`; products `vax-b` then `vax-a` (not live); series `duo-a` (product `vax-a`: dose 1 min age 6w at 2m; dose 2 min interval 8w at 3m) then `duo-b` (product `vax-b`: dose 1 min age 6w at 2m; dose 2 min interval 4w at 4m): at dose 2 one candidate has the later earliest date and the other the later due and overdue dates, and product order differs from series order | the merge across candidates takes earliest, due and overdue each on its own (EQ6 item 2), not one whole candidate; `products` in snapshot order, not candidate order |
| `illustrative-start-age.json` | since S3b (version `illustrative-start-age-s3b`): `hpv` with one product `gardasil9` (not live) and one product group of two bracketed series: `hpv-g9-9to14`, start age `[9y, 15y)`, 2 doses (dose 1 min age 9y at 9y; dose 2 min interval 5m at `firstDose` + 6m); `hpv-g9-15to45`, start age `[15y, 46y)`, 3 doses (dose 1 min age 9y, not 15y, at 15y; dose 2 min interval 4w at `firstDose` + 2m; dose 3 min interval 12w, `minIntervalFromFirst` 5m, at `firstDose` + 6m); no max ages | start-age brackets (S3b): the bracket chosen from the age at dose 1 and per birth end with no dose (EQ10), `AGE_AT_START_UNCERTAIN`, the most-doses rule (F05.5), dose-1 candidates including floating level-4 doses (Q32, Q49), no birth date (Q37), `outOfAge` and the `fullBirthDate` hint override (Q24), the `IMPLIED_EARLIER_DOSES` cap at the chosen series (Q48) |
| `minimal-start-age-gap.json` | since S3b: one generic group in disease `gap`, no products, every dose 1 min age 1y: `gap-a` `[1y, 2y)` (dose 1 at 1y; dose 2 min interval 8w at `previousDose` + 2m), `gap-b` `[3y, 5y)` (dose 1 at 3y; dose 2 min interval 4w at `previousDose` + 6m), `gap-c` open-ended `[5y, —)` (one dose at 5y) | an age in a gap between brackets uses the next bracket above, with and without doses (Q33), and the reach rule: a dose-1 age range that may fall in a bracket or in the gap above it also matches the bracket above the gap; a tie on most doses keeps every tied bracket and merges them (Q34); an open-ended bracket (Q25) |
| `minimal-start-age-gap-late.json` | since S3b: `minimal-start-age-gap` with `gap-a`'s dose 1 recommended at 18m (min age still 1y) | a no-dose birth range across a bracket's `max` whose older sub-range's end is 🔴 while the later end is 🟡: the birth-range split (F1) and the birth-narrowing property across bracket changes |
| `minimal-start-age-groups.json` | since S3b: disease `grp`, product `grp-x` (not live), every dose 1 min age 6m; generic `grp-gen-a` `[6m, 2y)` (dose 1 at 6m; dose 2 min interval 4w at `previousDose` + 2m) and `grp-gen-b` `[2y, 5y)` (one dose at 2y); product series `grp-x-a` `[6m, 3y)` (dose 1 at 6m; dose 2 min interval 8w at `previousDose` + 3m) and `grp-x-b` `[3y, 6y)` (one dose at 3y): every bracket ends within 20 years | two product groups with brackets: birth sub-ranges that choose different multi-series lists and agree or disagree (Q40, A8), an `outOfAge` oldest sub-range, one `AGE_AT_START_UNCERTAIN` per group; the property generator reaches `outOfAge` and "older than every bracket" |
